institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
problem_solved: The lack of localized hydro-geological data, precise contaminant tracing, accredited environmental impact data, and standardized water budgeting frameworks for industrial, municipal, and agricultural governance.
description: A comprehensive suite of analytical, field-based, and modeling services for advanced water resource and environmental management. Services include 1D/2D electrical resistivity tomography for aquifer profiling, stable isotope analysis ($^1\text{H}$, $^2\text{H}$, $^{18}\text{O}$, $^{13}\text{C}$) for environmental forensics, NABET-accredited Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA), groundwater transport modeling, automated water budgeting guidelines, and rigorous chemical/microbiological water and soil testing.
applications:
• Local Self-Government Institutions (LSGIs) for community water budgeting plans

• Infrastructure developers requiring structural bedrock mapping and EIA clearances

• Industrial bodies tracking effluent plume paths and groundwater contaminants

• Agricultural and watershed boards managing irrigation capacities and soil health
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
